summary: A device holding a space's room the server no longer grants (a space it never learned had ended, or a server whose data was reset) subscribed to it on every connection. The broker refused it and ended the whole session, so the client refreshed its token and reconnected forever: no live updates reached the device, and screens waiting on them spun. The token response now lists the topics it grants and the client subscribes only to those; a refused topic is asked about once and then left out.
